items.label: Is SmartERP suitable for a small manufacturing business?
items.children: Yes. SmartERP is designed to scale from small workshops to larger factory operations, so teams can start lean and expand later.

items.label: Do I need technical knowledge to use it?
items.children: No. The product is designed for operational teams, and onboarding can be done without an internal engineering team.

items.label: Is our data secure?
items.children: Your workspace data is isolated by tenant, protected in transit, and backed by standard operational safeguards.

items.label: Can we cancel whenever we want?
items.children: Yes. Trial access and future paid plans are intended to stay flexible so businesses can evaluate without long lock-in.
